Looking at this Chandelure card from Noble Victories, I'll perform a systematic inspection focusing on surface defects, creases, and structural issues (corners and edges are pre-measured).

## Initial Assessment
This is a reverse holo Chandelure with a gold/olive border and holographic pattern across the text box area. The card appears to be in good overall condition with the holofoil showing typical rainbow shimmer patterns.

## CATASTROPHIC SCAN (Both Sides First)
**Front:** Examining for creases - checking diagonals from each corner, horizontal mid-card lines. The emboss filter (image 5) shows the natural texture of the holofoil pattern but no continuous line discontinuities crossing the card that would indicate a crease. The high-pass image (7) confirms surface texture is consistent with holo pattern, no structural breaks visible.

**Back:** Checking the back carefully for creases. The emboss filter (image 6) shows the standard Pokemon back design. I see the natural energy swirl patterns - these are soft-edged and curved, part of the design. No straight fractured lines crossing through the Pokeball or spanning the card width. The high-pass (image 8) confirms no crease lines.

No tears, paper loss, water damage, or writing detected on either side.

## FRONT SURFACE INSPECTION
- The holofoil area shows typical rainbow shimmer - this is normal holo pattern, not damage
- The gold border appears clean and intact
- Artwork window shows Chandelure clearly with no print defects
- Text areas are crisp and legible
- No scratches cutting across the holo pattern
- No dents, pits, or indentations visible
- The bright areas in the holo section are foil reflection, not damage (soft-edged, follows light)

## BACK SURFACE INSPECTION
- The blue background appears uniform
- Pokeball artwork is intact
- The white energy swirls are part of the design (soft-edged, curved)
- No stains or discoloration
- Surface appears clean with no scratches or pits visible
- No print defects detected

## Glare Assessment
Front: Minor glare from the holofoil reflection, particularly in the middle/lower portion where the holo pattern is most active. This is normal for reverse holo cards.
Back: Minimal glare, good image quality.

## Re-check Against Detection Bias
- Structural defects: None found after thorough scan
- The pre-measured corner/edge data shows minor wear on back top-left and bottom-left corners - these are already captured by the measurement system
- No surface defects to report

**Final Assessment:**
The card is in excellent condition. The holofoil shimmer and glare are normal for this card type. No structural damage detected. The automated corner measurements captured the only notable wear.
